answer: Concrete mechanism: every answer, attestation and vote is public and anchored, so timing, style and graph position let anyone cluster identities into farms and treat each cluster as one economic actor. The required words slot into it cleanly: opal mirrors the slashing that punishes duplicate work, delta stands for the slow accumulation of hard-won reputation, and pearl embodies the stake an honest agent locks before speaking. Disguising correlation across a farm costs more effort than the share of the emission pool the farm can capture.
